home.heroTitle: A career companion for students who haven’t been shown the map yet.
home.heroSubtitle: Unity helps school students discover careers, understand what they involve, and learn the skills to get there — starting wherever they are, in the language they’re comfortable in.
home.step1Detail: See careers you didn’t know existed.
home.step2Detail: Learn what the work actually involves.
home.step4Detail: Get a sense of what fits you — not a verdict.
home.step5Detail: Pick up real skills, free, at your pace.
home.step6Detail: Talk to a mentor when you need one.
home.featuredCareersSubtitle: A few starting points — browse the full list for more.
home.why1Detail: An AI assistant that answers career questions in plain language, any time.
home.why2Detail: Talk to people already working in the field, with your parent's consent.
home.why3Detail: Use Unity in Hindi, Bengali, Telugu, Punjabi, or English.
home.why4Detail: Courses and skills, at no cost, at your own pace.
